english:
It looks like every Nobody in the
Organization is good at different things.
arabic:
يبدو أن كل واحد من اللا أحد في
المنظمة يتقن أشياء مختلفة.

english:
That's right.
Everybody's unique.
Even Nobodies without hearts?
arabic: حتى اللا أحد الذين لا قلوب لهم؟

english:
Just because we don't all have hearts
doesn't mean that we're all exactly the same.
arabic:
كوننا جميعا بلا قلوب
لا يعني أننا متشابهون تماما.

english: We each have memories of our pasts.
Memories?
You remember your past?

Yeah, that's one of the things that makes
each member of the Organization special.
arabic:
نعم، هذا أحد الأمور التي تجعل
كل عضو في المنظمة مميزا.

english: We remember who we were as humans.
arabic: نتذكر من كنا عندما كنا بشرا.

english: But I don't.
Me neither.

Well, maybe that right there is what makes
you guys the most unique in the Organization.
arabic:
حسنا، ربما هذا بالذات ما يجعلكما
أكثر أعضاء المنظمة تميزا.

english:
What were you like before
you were a Nobody?
arabic:
كيف كنت قبل أن تصبح
واحدا من اللا أحد؟

english: Huh? Me?

Oh, I dunno. I think I've always been
pretty much the same.
arabic:
لا أعرف. أظن أنني كنت دائما
كما أنا تقريبا.

english: I wish I could remember stuff like that.
Really? It's just baggage, you know.
arabic: حقا؟ إنها مجرد عبء، كما تعلم.

english:
But I--I can't remember anything.
Not even from when I was born a Nobody.
arabic:
لكنني... لا أتذكر أي شيء.
ولا حتى من وقت ولادتي كواحد من اللا أحد.

english: All you did was stare into space!
arabic: كل ما كنت تفعله هو التحديق في الفراغ!

english: Oh, thanks!
You know, I don't remember much, either.
arabic: أتعلمان؟ أنا أيضا لا أتذكر الكثير.

english: You two sure do have a lot in common.
arabic: لديكما الكثير من القواسم المشتركة حقا.

english: I wonder what kind of guy I was before...
arabic: أتساءل أي نوع من الأشخاص كنت سابقا...

english: Thanks, Roxas.
You can have this back.
Do you remember anything?
I don't know...but let me try again.
arabic: لا أعرف... لكن دعني أحاول مجددا.

english: You did it!
Roxas! It worked!
I can't wait to tell Axel this. Let's go!
arabic: لا أطيق الانتظار لإخبار آكسل. هيا بنا!

english: Yeah!
Axel!
Whoa! Where'd you come from?
How was your mission?

You know, I sure wish the Heartless
would hold still once in a while.
arabic:
أتعلمان؟ ليت بلا قلب
يثبتون في أماكنهم أحيانا.

english: I fell right on my butt chasing them around.
I thought you said you were tough.

Yeah, whatever, that's got
nothing to do with it.
arabic:
نعم، أيا يكن، هذا
لا علاقة له بالأمر.

english: So, how did your caper go?
Ta-daaah!
Roxas, Axel, thank you.
I didn't do anything.

You made it possible for the two of us
to go on a mission together.
arabic:
بفضلك استطعنا نحن الاثنان
الذهاب في مهمة معا.

english: If it weren't for you,

Xion might never have remembered
how to use the Keyblade.
arabic:
ربما لم تتذكر شيون أبدا
كيفية استخدام الكيبلايد.

english: So thanks, Axel.
How 'bout a sea salt ice cream, then?
arabic: ما رأيك في مثلجات ملح البحر إذن؟

english: Huh?
Buy me one, and we'll call it even.
You got it. I'll be right back!

I hope we can always be just
like this forever.
arabic:
آمل أن نظل دائما
هكذا إلى الأبد.

english: Me too.
What's that all about?

I just...want these days to last forever.
Hanging out, the ice cream, the sunsets...
arabic:
أنا فقط... أريد لهذه الأيام أن تدوم إلى الأبد.
قضاء الوقت معا، والمثلجات، والغروب...

english: Well, nothing lasts forever, you know?
arabic: حسنا، لا شيء يدوم إلى الأبد، تعلمين؟

english: Least of all for a bunch of Nobodies like us.
arabic: ولا سيما لجماعة من اللا أحد مثلنا.

english:
But it's okay if things change and
we can't meet up here.
arabic:
لكن لا بأس إن تغيرت الأمور
ولم نستطع اللقاء هنا.

english: Huh?

As long as we keep each other in our thoughts,
none of us will ever have to be apart.
arabic:
ما دمنا نتذكر بعضنا بعضا،
فلن نضطر أبدا إلى الافتراق.

english: Got it memorized?
Wow, that was so not you.
arabic: يا للعجب، هذا لا يشبهك أبدا.

english: Hey!

Ever heard of knocking?
What do you want?
arabic:
ألم تسمع بطرق الباب؟
ماذا تريد؟

english: Tell me what Xion has been doing.

Well, how should I know?
I'm not spying on her.
arabic:
وكيف لي أن أعرف؟
أنا لا أتجسس عليها.

english: The two of you look pretty close.

So what, now I've gotta rat
on my friends to you?
arabic:
وماذا الآن، هل علي أن أشي
بأصدقائي إليك؟

english: I think you should just go.

Today, you and Xion will be
going on the same mission.
arabic:
اليوم، ستذهب أنت وشيون
في المهمة نفسها.

english:
Well, thank you, sir, for personally
delivering that message to me.
arabic:
شكرا لك يا سيدي على
إيصال الرسالة إلي شخصيا.

english:
We also need you to go back to
Castle Oblivion soon.
arabic:
نحتاج أيضا إلى عودتك إلى
قلعة النسيان قريبا.

english: Says Lord Xemnas?
arabic: هل هذا أمر من السيد زيمناس؟

english: That castle hasn't given up all its secrets.
arabic: تلك القلعة لم تكشف كل أسرارها بعد.

english:
One even he doesn't know of its
whereabouts.
arabic:
أحدها لا يعرف حتى هو
مكانه.

english: Even he doesn't know...
You mean the chamber, right?

We turned that place inside out. If it's there,
we're not gonna find it just by looking.
arabic:
فتشنا المكان رأسا على عقب. إن كانت هناك،
فلن نجدها بمجرد البحث.

english: Then let me give you another reason.
Xion comes from the castle
to which Naminé can be traced.

The place where both
Naminé and Xion were born...
arabic:
المكان الذي ولدت فيه
ناميني وشيون...

english: It's practically calling out for you.
Whatever.

As far as the castle goes, you're the
one who really wants to go there.
arabic:
أما القلعة، فأنت
من يريد الذهاب إليها حقا.

english:
By finding the room that Xemnas
is searching for...
arabic:
بالعثور على الحجرة
التي يبحث عنها زيمناس...

english:
You would find out everything about
Xemnas's true agenda. Am I right?
arabic:
ستعرف كل شيء
عن مخطط زيمناس الحقيقي. أليس كذلك؟

english:
The Chamber of Repose as well as
the Chamber of Waking...

Xemnas has an agenda that
he hasn't told to anybody.
arabic:
لدى زيمناس مخطط
لم يخبر به أحدا.

english:
And we are bound to find some clues
in the Chamber of Waking.
arabic:
ولا بد أننا سنجد بعض الأدلة
في قاعة اليقظة.

english: And once we obtain those clues,

we'll have the upper hand
for our own objectives.
arabic:
ستكون لنا اليد العليا
في تحقيق أهدافنا الخاصة.

english:
I knew the time would come when
Vexen and Zexion got in your way.
arabic:
عرفت أن الوقت سيأتي
حين يعترض فيكسن وزيكسيون طريقك.

english: That's why I took the initiative...
and cleared the way to the top for you.

I can handle all the dirty work.
You go all the way to the top.
arabic:
يمكنني تولي كل الأعمال القذرة.
اصعد أنت إلى القمة.

english:
You will be going on a solo mission to
Castle Oblivion.
arabic:
ستذهب في مهمة منفردة
إلى قلعة النسيان.

english: Expect the orders soon.
Castle Oblivion...
Naminé...and Xion...
Roxas is late today.

Hope Xigbar isn't giving him
too hard of a time.
arabic:
آمل ألا يكون زيغبار
يرهقه كثيرا.

english: Yeah, right?
You know what, Axel?
Hm?
When I sit here and talk with you guys...
I get the strangest feeling...

that a long time ago, I used to watch
the sunset with somebody else.
arabic:
بأنني كنت أشاهد الغروب مع شخص آخر
منذ زمن بعيد.

english: It's the same when I watch the sea.
arabic: وأشعر بالأمر نفسه حين أشاهد البحر.

english:
Someplace by the sea...where
I hear the sound of the waves...
arabic:
في مكان ما بجوار البحر... حيث
أسمع صوت الأمواج...

english:
I get the feeling that I was
talking with someone.
arabic:
يراودني شعور بأنني كنت
أتحدث مع شخص ما.

english:
So you mean that...you have
memories of your past?
arabic:
إذن، تقصدين أن لديك
ذكريات عن ماضيك؟

english: No... It's not quite like that.
Well, I dunno.

What do you think?
Are these memories?
Huh... I wouldn't know, either.
You have memories, don't you?
Yeah, sorta.

Though it's not like they've
ever really done me any good.
arabic:
مع أنها لم تفدني
يوما في شيء حقا.

english:
Roxas is like me.
Neither one of us remembers much.
arabic:
روكساس مثلي.
لا يتذكر أي منا الكثير.

english:
I wonder if he and I...had this much
in common before we were Nobodies.
arabic:
أتساءل إن كنا أنا وهو... نتشابه
إلى هذا الحد قبل أن نصبح من اللا أحد.

english: I knew you'd be here.
Axel...
Slept like a log.

Are the kids here on summer vacation already? 
...Nah, can't be. It's much too early.
arabic:
هل بدأ الأطفال هنا العطلة الصيفية بالفعل؟
...لا، لا يمكن. ما زال الوقت مبكرا جدا.

english:
Summer vacation?
What's that?

It's a dream come true, that's what-- 
where they get a whole month off.
arabic:
إنها حلم أصبح حقيقة،
إذ يحصلون على شهر كامل من الإجازة.

english: A month off!?

I wouldn't know what to do
with that much time.
arabic:
لن أعرف ماذا أفعل
بكل ذلك الوقت.

english: I can't even figure out how to fill a day.
arabic: حتى إنني لا أعرف كيف أملأ يوما واحدا.

english: You'd be surprised.

They give you plenty of homework,
and of course,

you have to play with your friends
everyday.
arabic:
عليك أن تلعب مع أصدقائك
كل يوم.

english: Trust me, it's over before you can blink.
Hmm... I could deal with seven days, maybe.
arabic: همم... ربما أستطيع تدبر سبعة أيام.

english:
Most kids spend the time just
goofing off with their friends.
arabic:
يقضي معظم الأطفال الوقت
في اللهو مع أصدقائهم.

english:
They save the homework till the end
and then help each other finish it.
arabic:
يؤجلون الواجبات إلى النهاية،
ثم يساعد بعضهم بعضا في إنجازها.

english: That sounds fun, I guess.
arabic: يبدو ذلك ممتعا، على ما أظن.

english: Hanging around with friends is fun.

I'd forgotten all that since becoming
a Nobody, I guess.
arabic:
أظن أنني نسيت كل ذلك
منذ صرت واحدا من اللا أحد.

english: So, how did you spend your day?

Hey, guys.
How did I know you'd be here?
arabic:
مرحبا يا رفاق.
كيف عرفت أنكما ستكونان هنا؟

english: Where did you go, Xion?
I didn't go anywhere.
What about you two?
Did you guys go somewhere without me?
arabic: هل ذهبتما إلى مكان ما من دوني؟

english: Axel says he was asleep all day.
arabic: يقول آكسل إنه نام طوال اليوم.

english:
What? What's that about?
You wasted a day off?

Unlike you two lazybones, I work hard,
so I'm tired, okay?
arabic:
أنا أعمل بجد، بخلافكما أيها الكسولان،
لذا أنا متعب، مفهوم؟

english:
Unlike me and Roxas, maybe you're
just out of shape!
arabic:
ربما لياقتك ضعيفة فحسب،
على عكسي وعكس روكساس!

english: Tomorrow, it's back to work.
Yeah...
Hope we get another vacation soon.
arabic: آمل أن نحصل على إجازة أخرى قريبا.

english:
Oh yeah... I might not see you guys
again for a while.
arabic:
آه، بالمناسبة... قد لا أراكما
مجددا لفترة.

english: Huh?

They're sending me out on recon for a
few days.
arabic:
سيرسلونني في مهمة استطلاعية
لبضعة أيام.

english: Where?
Can't tell.
What's up with that?
It's a secret mission.
But I thought we were friends.

Hey, I'm not about to tell you
ALL my dark secrets.
arabic:
اسمع، لن أخبركما
بكل أسراري المظلمة.

english: Got it memorized?
Dark secrets?
I'm kidding.

I just gotta keep my mouth shut about it,
or else Saïx will get on my case.
arabic:
علي فقط أن أكتم الأمر،
وإلا فسيوبخني سايكس.

english: You know how he can get.
Yeah.

Try not to bungle everything
while I'm gone, huh?
arabic:
حاولا ألا تفسدا كل شيء
في غيابي، اتفقنا؟

english: Now, why would we do that?

Well, considering your track record,
I just can't count on you guys.
arabic:
نظرا إلى سوابقكما،
لا أستطيع الاعتماد عليكما.

english: Hey!
We can handle things just fine!
That's right, just you watch!
What took you so long?

It's my vacation. I can take
all the time I want.
arabic:
هذه إجازتي. يمكنني أن أتمهل
قدر ما أشاء.

english: Since when do I have to check in with you?
arabic: منذ متى علي إبلاغك بما أفعل؟

english:
You're letting yourself get
too attached to them.
arabic:
أنت تسمح لنفسك
بالتعلق بهما أكثر من اللازم.

english: Yeah, yeah, whatever you say.
You know, you've changed...
Hey, Roxas!
Axel... You're back!
Yup, I just got home.
So, are ya holding up?
Yeah.
Where's Xion?
She's not here yet.
Hunh.
She's usually here by now.
arabic: عادة ما تكون هنا في هذا الوقت.

english: This isn't like her...
How could he...
I'm not a sham...
Just give me another chance!

We can't afford to take
any more chances on you.
arabic:
لا يمكننا المجازفة
بمنحك مزيد من الفرص.

english:
You were a mistake we never
should have made.
arabic:
كنت خطأ لم يكن ينبغي لنا
ارتكابه أصلا.

english: Xion?
Where's Xion?
Haven't seen her today.
Oh well.
Axel...
Hm?
Is there anything you couldn't bear to lose?
arabic: هل هناك شيء لا تطيق فقدانه؟

english: Anything I couldn't bear to lose?
What's that about?

Well, I met someone today
who had something like that.
arabic:
قابلت اليوم شخصا
لديه شيء كهذا.

english:
This thing was so important to him
he couldn't bear to lose it...
arabic:
كان ذلك الشيء عزيزا عليه
إلى حد لا يطيق معه فقدانه...

english: and Xaldin said that was his weakness.
arabic: وقال زالدين إن تلك نقطة ضعفه.

english: Why don't I have anything like that?
It's because you don't have a heart.
I guess...

But Demyx doesn't have a heart, and I bet
he'd get upset if you took his sitar away.
arabic:
لكن ديميكس لا يملك قلبا، وأنا واثق
أنه سينزعج إن أخذت آلة السيتار منه.

english: Huh... I think you have a point there.
arabic: همم... أظن أنك محق في ذلك.

english:
So you don't need a heart to have
something that you can't bear to lose then.
arabic:
إذن، لا تحتاج إلى قلب كي يكون
لديك شيء لا تطيق فقدانه.

english:
If that's true, then I guess the
closest thing that we Nobodies have
arabic:
إن صح ذلك، فأظن أن أقرب
شيء نملكه نحن اللا أحد

english: would be memories of our past.

It's the memories that create
the things that we don't want to lose.
arabic:
الذكريات هي التي تصنع
الأشياء التي لا نريد فقدانها.

english: Memories of the past...
I don't remember MY past.

Even though you might not remember the past,
I'm sure you have things you don't wanna lose.
arabic:
حتى إن لم تتذكر الماضي،
فأنا واثق أن لديك أشياء لا تريد فقدانها.

english: Like what?

You've got memories since
you joined us, right?
arabic:
لديك ذكريات منذ
انضمامك إلينا، صحيح؟

english: I dunno...
I do, don't I?

I couldn't bear to lose
my memories of you or Xion.
arabic:
لا أطيق فقدان
ذكرياتي عنك وعن شيون.

english:
So then you really do have something
that you can't bear to lose, right?
arabic:
إذن، لديك بالفعل شيء
لا تطيق فقدانه، صحيح؟

english:
Every one of us--including us Nobodies--we all
have something that we want to hang on to.
arabic:
كل واحد منا، حتى نحن اللا أحد،
يملك شيئا يريد التمسك به.

english: It's scary.
You can't be scared without a heart!
arabic: لا يمكنك أن تخاف من دون قلب!

english: If my friends...
If you or Xion were to disappear...

It's...scary to think of what it would
be like without you guys.
arabic:
من المخيف... أن أفكر كيف
ستكون الأمور من دونكما.

english:
"Scared" is not an emotion that
can exist inside us.
arabic:
«الخوف» ليس شعورا
يمكن أن يوجد في داخلنا.

english: Well...
I am scared right now, for sure.

Maybe it's just that you remember
what it's like to be scared, you know?
arabic:
ربما تتذكر فحسب
كيف يكون الشعور بالخوف، أتفهم؟

english: Somewhere deep inside your memories.
arabic: في مكان ما في أعماق ذكرياتك.

english: I wonder where Axel is.

Guess we got the work done a little
TOO fast, huh?
arabic:
أظن أننا أنهينا العمل
بسرعة زائدة قليلا، أليس كذلك؟

english: Xion?
Xion!
Something wrong?

Sorry. 
My mind's on other things.

Roxas, do you ever think...about
why we're doing all of this?
arabic:
روكساس، هل تفكر يوما...
في سبب قيامنا بكل هذا؟

english:
What do you mean, why? 
So we can get hearts of our own, right?
arabic:
ماذا تقصدين بالسبب؟
لنحصل على قلوب خاصة بنا، صحيح؟

english: But what do we need hearts for?
I don't know.
But I think once we have hearts,
arabic: لكنني أظن أننا عندما نحصل على قلوب،

english:
we probably won't have to think about
why we're doing all this,
arabic:
لن نحتاج على الأرجح إلى التساؤل
عن سبب قيامنا بكل هذا،

english: or if we need hearts.
arabic: ولا عما إن كنا نحتاج إلى القلوب.

english: I'm not sure.
I just wish
I knew what I was doing here.
I started having the strangest dreams.
Like nightmares?
I can never remember what they're about.
arabic: لا أتذكر أبدا ما يدور فيها.

english: I just...wake up scared.

Xigbar said you and me were pretty
special. "Exceptional," he said.
arabic:
قال زيغبار إنني وأنت مميزان جدا.
قال إننا «استثنائيان».

english: Special? Isn't that...

just another way of saying
that I'm a mistake?
arabic:
مجرد طريقة أخرى للقول
إنني خطأ؟

english: You're not a mistake.

Well, you and I may both be
exceptional, Roxas,
arabic:
قد نكون نحن الاثنان
استثنائيين يا روكساس،

english: but...I don't think we're quite the same.
arabic: لكن... لا أظن أننا متشابهان تماما.

english: Xion...
Heya, Roxas!
Axel...
Xion couldn't make it again today?
arabic: ألم تستطع شيون المجيء اليوم أيضا؟

english: Actually, you just missed her.
arabic: في الحقيقة، لقد رحلت قبل وصولك مباشرة.

english: Xion...
Hey, that was uncalled for!
arabic: مهلا، لم يكن هناك داع لذلك!

english: I told you. Keep out of this.

And I'm telling you that I have
to know what's the deal with Xion.
arabic:
وأنا أخبرك بأن علي
معرفة ما يجري مع شيون.

english:
If there's something going on, just be
straight with me for once, will ya?
arabic:
إن كان هناك شيء يحدث، فكن صريحا
معي ولو لمرة، أتفعل؟

english:
Do you mean just like you are
always honest with me?
arabic:
أتقصد أن أكون صريحا
كما تكون أنت صريحا معي دائما؟

english: Well, you've got me there, I guess.
Xion has no right to be among our number.
arabic: ليس لشيون حق في أن تكون بيننا.

english: What do you mean?

It's plain to see.
I have nothing more to say.
arabic:
الأمر واضح.
ليس لدي ما أضيفه.

english: Uh...  Good morning, Xion.
Oh... Morning...

You woke up so suddenly,
you just startled me.
S-sorry...
Oh...
Did you bring me these seashells?
Do you hear it?
Yeah, the sound of the waves.
How long was I asleep?
About twenty days.
That long!?

Yeah. You were sleeping so much that
me and Axel were getting worried.
arabic:
نعم. نمت طويلا إلى حد
جعلني أنا وآكسل نقلق عليك.

english: I'm sorry about that.

Kind of weird that we can feel anything
at all. Without having hearts to feel with.
arabic:
من الغريب أننا نستطيع الشعور بأي شيء
من دون قلوب نشعر بها.

english:
Hey, Roxas.
Don't you have work today?
arabic:
اسمع يا روكساس.
أليس لديك عمل اليوم؟

english: Huh? Oh, I'm about to head out.
arabic: ماذا؟ آه، كنت على وشك الانطلاق.

english: I'd like to tag along.
But don't you need some more rest?
arabic: لكن ألا تحتاجين إلى مزيد من الراحة؟

english: I'll be fine. C'mon, take me with you.
All right... Sure.
Xion!
Leave Xion to me.
Got it!

Well, that didn't take long.
Did it break again?
arabic:
لم يطل الأمر، إذن.
هل تعطل ذلك الشيء مجددا؟

english: She's not an "it"!
Keep your mouth shut.
You have changed...
What happened at Castle Oblivion?
Does the past mean nothing to you?
Are you worried about her, Axel?
arabic: هل أنت قلق عليها يا آكسل؟

english: Of course I am.
It just doesn't seem like you.
arabic: الأمر فقط أن هذا لا يشبهك.

english: What do you mean?

I mean, you don't like things
to be complicated.
arabic:
أقصد أنك لا تحب
أن تكون الأمور معقدة.

english: You know, Roxas...

Each day the three of us meet up there for
ice cream. Now, why do you think that is?
arabic:
نلتقي نحن الثلاثة هناك كل يوم
لتناول المثلجات. لماذا تظن أننا نفعل ذلك؟

english: Huh?

I mean, if you think about it, I don't need to
go out of my way to meet you guys, right?
arabic:
أقصد أنني، إن فكرت في الأمر، لست مضطرا
إلى بذل الجهد للقائكما، أليس كذلك؟

english: I don't know...
You want me to tell you why?

It's because you guys
are my best friends.
We are?

Get it memorized, alright?
We are best friends.
arabic:
احفظ ذلك جيدا، مفهوم؟
نحن أعز الأصدقاء.

english: Oh yeah...
Guess we are.
Heh heh...

Thanks, Axel.
You're sweet.
Are you feeling better?

I just got a little dizzy, that's all.
Sorry to worry you guys.
arabic:
شعرت بدوار بسيط فقط، هذا كل شيء.
آسفة لأنني أقلقتكما.

english: Don't scare us like that anymore.
Just take it easy today.
I will. Thanks. Both of you.

THE TRUTH ABOUT NAMINÉ
  Vexen
Hey, Axel?
Hm?
You've been to Castle Oblivion, right?
arabic: لقد ذهبت إلى قلعة النسيان، صحيح؟

english: Yeah.
What is it like?

What's it like? Just an Organization
research facility.
arabic:
كيف تبدو؟ إنها مجرد منشأة
أبحاث تابعة للمنظمة.

english: For research, huh?
arabic: مع أنهم... لا يرسلونني ولا روكساس أبدا.

english:
Seems everyone gets sent there
all the time. Especially you.
arabic:
يبدو أن الجميع يرسلون إلى هناك
باستمرار. وخاصة أنت.

english: Although...they never send me or Roxas.
arabic: مع أنهم... لا يرسلونني أنا وروكساس أبدا.

english:
Well...they probably just don't
need you there.
arabic:
حسنا... ربما لا
يحتاجون إليكما هناك فحسب.

english: I'm...I'm heading back.
Huh?
Maybe you're not completely well yet.
No, it's nothing like that.
Got it!
Huh? Got what?

On our next day off, let's all
go to the beach, huh?
arabic:
في إجازتنا القادمة، لنذهب جميعا
إلى الشاطئ، ما رأيكما؟

english:
The beach?
Where did that idea come from?
arabic:
الشاطئ؟
من أين أتتك هذه الفكرة؟

english:
We should go someplace
different for a change.
arabic:
علينا الذهاب إلى مكان
مختلف على سبيل التغيير.

english: You're talking about a vacation with friends.
arabic: أنت تتحدث عن إجازة مع الأصدقاء.

english: Exactly.
I'll join you...if I can.
What are you talking about, Xion?
It'll be a blast, trust me.
Yes, all right.
Let's go.
I sent Axel to Castle Oblivion last night
arabic: أرسلت آكسل إلى قلعة النسيان ليلة أمس

english: to help expedite the matter we spoke of.

I also instructed him to
clear out our facilities there.
He should return soon.
And what of Naminé?
Still missing, sir.
Where, oh where could she be?
arabic: أين، يا ترى، يمكن أن تكون؟

english:
Why, Xigbar...
It almost sounds as though you know.
arabic:
يا زيغبار...
يبدو من كلامك أنك تعرف.

english: Continue.

Somebody accessed our main computer
without authorization.
arabic:
دخل أحدهم إلى حاسوبنا الرئيسي
من دون تصريح.

english:
And you expect us to believe you
really don't know who it was? As if.
arabic:
وتتوقع منا أن نصدق أنك
لا تعرف من هو حقا؟ وكأننا سنصدق!

english: Little Poppet is turning into a problem.

Nonsense.
I see no problem whatsoever.
arabic:
هراء.
لا أرى أي مشكلة إطلاقا.

english: Well, no, apparently you don't!
arabic: نعم، يبدو بالفعل أنك لا تراها!

english: Something you find amusing?
arabic: هل تجد في الأمر ما يضحك؟

english:
Ah, the things you hear
from a guy with no heart.
arabic:
آه، يا للكلام الذي تسمعه
من شخص بلا قلب.

english:
No matter what unfolds,
our plans remain unchanged.
arabic:
مهما حدث،
تبقى خططنا كما هي.

english: Axel, Roxas, and Xion

will play the respective roles that
Kingdom Hearts has given them.
arabic:
سيؤدي كل منهم الدور
الذي منحه إياه كينغدوم هارتس.

english: But sir, Xion--
Leave it be.

How can you not see how perfect this is?
In truth, this is more than perfect.
arabic:
كيف لا ترى مدى مثالية هذا؟
في الحقيقة، إنه أكثر من مثالي.

english:
Xion is marching right into the arms of
destiny, but to destiny's own time.
arabic:
شيون تسير مباشرة إلى أحضان
القدر، لكن في الوقت الذي يحدده هو.

english:
We need not take any more steps. All we
must do is watch with caution and patience.
arabic:
لا نحتاج إلى أي خطوات أخرى. كل ما علينا
هو المراقبة بحذر وصبر.

english: My head...hurts...
This is the last you'll ever see of these walls,
arabic: هذه آخر مرة سترين فيها هذه الجدران،

english: Xion.
Axel... What are you doing here...?
I'm just here on orders, that's all.
There's nothing for you to see here.
Lies!
This is the place I come from. I just know it.
arabic: هذا هو المكان الذي أتيت منه. أنا واثقة.

english: What about your mission?
Don't be selfish.
Or else they'll turn me into a Dusk?
They'll do worse than turn you into a Dusk.
arabic: سيفعلون ما هو أسوأ من تحويلك إلى الداسك.

english: They'll just destroy you.
And is that because I'm useless?
That's not it.
Xion, go home.

I'm remembering things. I have
memories of back when I was a human.
arabic:
بدأت أتذكر أشياء. لدي
ذكريات من أيام كنت إنسانة.

english:
Well, stop remembering.
Nothing good will come of it.
arabic:
إذن، توقفي عن التذكر.
لن يأتي منه خير.

english:
I have dreams every night.
And you're in those dreams, Axel!
arabic:
أرى أحلاما كل ليلة.
وأنت فيها يا آكسل!

english:
Then they sure aren't memories.
How could I be a part of your past?
arabic:
إذن، فهي ليست ذكريات بالتأكيد.
كيف يمكن أن أكون جزءا من ماضيك؟

english: They're just dreams, that's all.
You can't fool me.

We've met before,
Axel, right here in this castle!
arabic:
لقد التقينا من قبل،
يا آكسل، هنا في هذه القلعة!

english: No, we have not.
Let's go home, Xion.
Don't keep Roxas waiting.
Please, Axel...you've got to help me!
I need to know who I am.
Stop! Stay out of there, Xion!
arabic: توقفي! لا تدخلي إلى هناك يا شيون!

english: Wh-What...
Then I...wasn't who I am...?
arabic: إذن، أنا... لست من كنت أظن...؟

english: So we meet again.
You made me a promise.

I remember.
It was to look after Sora.

I'm sorry... I'm not sure I've kept
that promise very well.
arabic:
أنا آسف... لست واثقا أنني
وفيت بذلك الوعد كما ينبغي.

english: Can you tell me what's happening?
Some of Sora's memories are missing.
How could that be?

Sora's memories are escaping through
Sora's Nobody into a third person--
arabic:
تتسرب ذكريات سورا عبر
اللا أحد المنبثق منه إلى شخص ثالث،

english:
and now they're starting to
become a part of her.

Isn't there a way to bring back
just Sora's memories?
arabic:
أليست هناك طريقة لاستعادة
ذكريات سورا وحدها؟

english:
If they're still separate...then I think
I can take out fragments of it.
arabic:
إن كانت لا تزال منفصلة... فأظن
أنني أستطيع انتزاع شظايا منها.

english:
But if her memories and Sora's memory
fragments are completely weaved together...
arabic:
لكن إن كانت ذكرياتها وشظايا ذكريات سورا
قد تشابكت تماما...

english:
I would need to untangle them from
each other and that would take more time.
arabic:
فسأحتاج إلى فصل بعضها
عن بعض، وهذا سيستغرق وقتا أطول.

english:
Which means it would take even longer
before Sora can wake up again.
arabic:
وهذا يعني مزيدا من التأخير
قبل أن يستيقظ سورا مجددا.

english: And DiZ wouldn't tolerate that.
So what can you do?
If I just jump in and rearrange her memory...
arabic: إن تدخلت مباشرة وأعدت ترتيب ذاكرتها...

english: ...then Sora might wake up

only to find out that nobody
remembers him anymore.
arabic:
ليكتشف أن أحدا
لم يعد يتذكره.

english: That's a risk I just can't take.
It's too late either way.
Sora's awakening has already been delayed.

Sora's Nobody and the one that's
absorbing his memory...
arabic:
اللا أحد المنبثق من سورا، وتلك
التي تمتص ذكرياته...

english:
None of us imagined that they would fight
so hard to become their own people.
arabic:
لم يتخيل أحد منا أنهما سيقاتلان
بهذه الشراسة ليكون لكل منهما كيانه الخاص.

english: Unfortunately, the only real solution...
is for them both to go away.
Did you know her face was blank at first?
arabic: هل كنت تعلم أن وجهها كان خاليا من الملامح في البداية؟

english:
But now...there is a face
that is clearly visible.
arabic:
لكن الآن... هناك وجه
واضح الملامح.

english:
I think that's proof that she has
entered Sora's memories.
arabic:
أظن أن هذا دليل
على دخولها إلى ذكريات سورا.

english:
Sora's memories, Sora's Nobody's
memories, and her memories...
arabic:
ذكريات سورا، وذكريات اللا أحد
المنبثق منه، وذكرياتها...

english:
They're all a jumbled mess now.
And to put them back into one...
arabic:
كلها متشابكة الآن.
ولجمعها في كيان واحد مجددا...

english: I'm afraid there's no other way.
arabic: أخشى أنه لا توجد طريقة أخرى.

english: All right.
Hey... It's been a while.
You think so?
So...I went to the beach today.

And there was this girl who looked
kind of like Xion...
arabic:
وكانت هناك فتاة تشبه
شيون بعض الشيء...

english:
but I couldn't get close enough to
tell for sure.
arabic:
لكنني لم أستطع الاقتراب بما يكفي
لأتأكد.

english: I probably imagined it.

To be honest, I'm not even sure
today's mission really happened.
arabic:
بصراحة، لست متأكدا حتى
من أن مهمة اليوم حدثت حقا.

english:
Feels like I just woke up from a dream
or something.
arabic:
أشعر كأنني استيقظت للتو من حلم
أو شيء من هذا القبيل.

english: Do you remember our promise?

When we said that the three of us would
go to the beach on our next break?
arabic:
حين قلنا إننا سنذهب نحن الثلاثة
إلى الشاطئ في إجازتنا القادمة؟

english: Maybe that's why.

Maybe I saw Xion there
because I wanted her to be there.
arabic:
ربما رأيت شيون هناك
لأنني أردتها أن تكون هناك.

english: Wanna go look for her?
Huh?

Beginning tomorrow, let's use
our spare time to find Xion.
arabic:
ابتداء من الغد، لنستخدم
وقت فراغنا للعثور على شيون.

english: Mm-hmm.
Sounds good, let's do that.
It's no use.
You sure you're not forgetting some place?
arabic: أمتأكد أنك لم تنس مكانا ما؟

english: I've been everywhere I know how to get to.
arabic: ذهبت إلى كل مكان أعرف كيف أصل إليه.

english: Alright...

The only place I haven't been to
is Castle Oblivion.
arabic:
المكان الوحيد الذي لم أذهب إليه
هو قلعة النسيان.

english:
It was just the other day that Xion was
asking you what the place was like.
arabic:
منذ أيام قليلة فقط، كانت شيون
تسألك كيف يبدو ذلك المكان.

english: And the day before she disappeared,

you said she was put on an important
mission. Remember?
arabic:
قلت إنها كلفت
بمهمة ذات أهمية. أتذكر؟

english: Yeah...
But there's nothing there anymore.
Well, Xion might be there.

Apparently...Xion comes from
Castle Oblivion.
arabic:
يبدو... أن شيون أتت من
قلعة النسيان.

english: What?

That's probably why she was
asking about the place.
arabic:
ربما لهذا كانت
تسأل عن المكان.

english: I had no idea...
Me neither.
I only found out a little while ago.
arabic: لم أعرف إلا منذ فترة قصيرة.

english: Castle Oblivion...
Xion...
So, this is Castle Oblivion...
Roxas!?
My...my head!

Easy, man!
Let's retreat for now and--
arabic:
على مهلك يا رجل!
لننسحب الآن ثم...

english: I'm fine!
We have to...find Xion...
Wh...what's happening?
Roxas!
So much...rushing into...
my head...
Let's get out of here for now!
No, wait...
There's...something...
I can...almost...

Giving up already? 
I thought you were stronger than that.
arabic:
أتستسلم بهذه السرعة؟
ظننت أنك أقوى من ذلك.

english: Riku!
Are you alright?
What...happened to me?

You collapsed just as you
entered the castle doors.
Don't you remember?
I only remember going inside.
Just take it easy for now.
arabic: خذ قسطا من الراحة الآن فحسب.

english:
I'm fine. Let's go back to
Castle Oblivion.
arabic:
أنا بخير. لنعد إلى
قلعة النسيان.

english: Don't push yourself, man.
Who's there?
Xion?
Xion, wait!
Out of the way!
Hey!
Roxas, wait!
